hook: Kuiper belt dust grains were altered by heavy-oxygen water, hinting at an outer solar system reservoir.
summary: Dust particles collected in Earth's stratosphere that likely come from Kuiper belt objects show oxygen isotopes consistent with alteration by water rich in heavy oxygen. This points to a heavy-water ice reservoir beyond the giant planets, isolated from inner solar system material. The conclusion rests on a small number of rare particles.
title: A primordial heavy water reservoir in the outer solar system.
